review_description: Excellent customer service, simple quote process & install was a breeze. On going customer service still exceptional. Highly recommend Just Energy

I was a bit sceptical about installing solar initially, but Brindley and Krishna made the process really smooth. I’m saving over half my normal bill per month at this stage and also have the option for a battery. The process was seamless, after signing up with Just Energy they took care of everything down to every detail. Could not recommend enough and have already had friends with the same experience that have used them as well. As well as the product them are very personal people and seem like they really care about what they are providing compared to other quotes I had earlier. Would definitely recommend and already have to others

Installed Solar with Just Energy and the Install was fantastic and the post Install they have provided constant service.  I have also referred  my sister who has also installed. Great work Brindley and Team and Krishna is also fantastic.
Had my solar system installed on time and in a professional manner. Great price and very friendly staff
Just energy had excellent customer service, providing confidence and information all the way through the process.

I found Brindley to be authentic and engaging during our initial discussions.  He took the time and care to step me through the whole process and how I would be supported post sale and was clear on all costs.  The whole process happened quickly and efficiently.  I am extremely happy with the all the works and now can see the positive impact my system is having on my electricity usage.  I would be happy to recommend Just Energy to anyone wanting a solar / clean energy solution.  Thanks so much Brindley.

Extremely professional from the quoting process to the final connection with customer service and price that cannot be matched! The Just Energy team went above and beyond during the whole process and they were a pleasure to work with.

The team at Just Energy promptly attended our home to give us a range of suitable options for our electricity needs. From installation to activation, the team kept us informed the whole way. The journey was an easy and comfortable one from our end. What did suprise us was the after sale service. Regular check ins to see how the systems were going, analysis of our power bills for optimum performance and saving us money. The service was beyond what we expected and would certainly, and have, recommended them to all our friends.
Quality install, quality customer service, Just Energy provide all levels of support and inform you of the capacity the system is

From the initial consultation to the final installation, their team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, clear communication, and genuine care for customer satisfaction. They explained every step in detail, answered all our questions promptly, and kept us informed throughout the process. The installation was completed on time with high-quality workmanship. It’s refreshing to deal with a company that values honesty and delivers exactly what they promise. Highly recommend Just Energy for anyone considering solar — a truly seamless and hassle-free experience!
